arguments.sql:
WITH runs AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, runs_scored AS runs
    FROM main.batsman_scored
    UNION ALL
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, extra_runs AS runs
    FROM main.extra_runs
),
bowling AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id,
           COUNT(DISTINCT bowler) AS bowler_count,
           COUNT(*) - COUNT(bowler) AS missing_bowler_balls
    FROM main.ball_by_ball
    GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id
),
scoring AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, SUM(runs) AS total_runs
    FROM runs
    GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id
),
overs AS (
    SELECT b.match_id, b.bowler_count, b.missing_bowler_balls,
           COALESCE(s.total_runs, 0) AS total_runs
    FROM bowling AS b
    LEFT JOIN scoring AS s USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id)
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *, DENSE_RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY match_id ORDER BY total_runs DESC
    ) AS run_rank
    FROM overs
),
top_counts AS (
    SELECT match_id, COUNT(*) AS top_count
    FROM ranked
    WHERE run_rank = 1
    GROUP BY match_id
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main."match") AS listed_matches,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM top_counts) AS matches_with_overs,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM top_counts WHERE top_count > 1) AS matches_with_ties,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM overs WHERE bowler_count <> 1) AS overs_without_unique_bowler,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ranked WHERE run_rank = 1 AND bowler_count <> 1) AS top_overs_without_unique_bowler,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ranked WHERE run_rank = 1 AND missing_bowler_balls > 0) AS top_overs_with_null_bowler_balls,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scoring AS s LEFT JOIN bowling AS b USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id)
     WHERE b.match_id IS NULL) AS scoring_overs_without_balls,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM top_counts AS t LEFT JOIN main."match" AS m USING (match_id)
     WHERE m.match_id IS NULL) AS unlisted_matches_with_balls,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM runs WHERE runs IS NULL) AS null_run_entries

arguments.sql:
WITH run_entries AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, runs_scored AS runs
    FROM main.batsman_scored
    UNION ALL
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, extra_runs AS runs
    FROM main.extra_runs
),
over_runs AS (
    SELECT match_id, innings_no, over_id, SUM(runs) AS total_runs
    FROM run_entries
    GROUP BY match_id, innings_no, over_id
),
played_overs AS (
    -- Include every match with recorded deliveries.
    SELECT DISTINCT match_id, innings_no, over_id
    FROM main.ball_by_ball
),
ranked_overs AS (
    SELECT o.match_id, o.innings_no, o.over_id,
           COALESCE(r.total_runs, 0) AS total_runs,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY o.match_id
               -- Select the earliest over among equally high totals.
               ORDER BY COALESCE(r.total_runs, 0) DESC, o.innings_no, o.over_id
           ) AS over_rank
    FROM played_overs AS o
    LEFT JOIN over_runs AS r USING (match_id, innings_no, over_id)
)
SELECT w.match_id, w.innings_no, w.over_id, w.total_runs,
       (
           SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(bowler)
           FROM (
               SELECT DISTINCT b.bowler
               FROM main.ball_by_ball AS b
               WHERE b.match_id = w.match_id
                 AND b.innings_no = w.innings_no
                 AND b.over_id = w.over_id
               ORDER BY b.bowler
           )
       ) AS bowler_ids,
       AVG(w.total_runs) OVER () AS avg_highest_over_runs
FROM ranked_overs AS w
WHERE w.over_rank = 1
ORDER BY w.match_id
LIMIT -1
